scope: sdk/typescript tracked paths; all paths enumerated, review depth explicit
source_base: published PR165 baseline with local uncommitted authorized hardening

findings.evidence: Synthetic pre-fix tenant symlink wrote/read outside configured root. Post-fix tests cover initial root/tenant links, post-construction root/tenant/manifests/by-decision/evidence/meta swaps, final object/descriptor/manifest links, trusted parent aliases and bounded FIFO subprocess.
findings.remaining_limit: Customer-controlled ancestors and no adversarial concurrent namespace mutation required. Node has no directory-relative openat API; path checks do not establish race-proof containment or parity with Python pinned descriptors.

findings.evidence: recordError/fail call span.recordException(err); provider installation has no metadata-only exporter wrapper.
findings.remaining_limit: Exception messages/stacks can reach host exporter; direct export is not uniformly metadata-only. No live external export performed.

findings.evidence: deliver increments stored/settles before removeSpool; removeSpool suppresses failures.
findings.remaining_limit: flush/stored count is not proof of durable source cleanup. No durable source/destination receipt parity claimed.

findings.evidence: extract calls parseMembers on entire header and decodeContext JSON/base64 decode without incoming size bound.
findings.remaining_limit: Inbound headers must be bounded by host HTTP layer; malformed-shape handling alone is not resource qualification.

findings.evidence: taskFromRecord checks checksum then casts descriptor/manifest and tenant fields without matching configured store tenant.
findings.remaining_limit: Customer must control spool files; checksum is corruption detection, not authorization against malicious local rewrites.
